text: Picture a corner shop with a tab book.
prefix: Picture a corner shop with a tab book.

text: You take your bread, and the shopkeeper writes one line in the book.
prefix: You take your bread, and the shopkeeper writes one line in the book.

text: No cash changes hands yet.
prefix: No cash changes hands yet.

text: At the end of the week, you settle up for every line at once.
prefix: At the end of the week, you settle up for every line at once.

text: A card payment works the same way.
prefix: A card payment works the same way.

text: Two banks take part in every card payment.
prefix: Two banks take part in every card payment.

text: The shop's bank is the acquirer.
prefix: The shop's bank is the acquirer.

text: It signs up shops, takes their payments and pays them out, and this course builds its system.
prefix: It signs up shops, takes their payments and pays them out, and this course builds its system.

text: The buyer's bank is the issuer.
prefix: The buyer's bank is the issuer.

text: It gave the buyer the card, and it holds the buyer's money.
prefix: It gave the buyer the card, and it holds the buyer's money.

text: Between them sits the card network, which carries messages from one bank to the other.
prefix: Between them sits the card network, which carries messages from one bank to the other.

text: When the buyer confirms the payment, the acquirer sends a question through the card network to the issuer: may this card pay this amount?
prefix: When the buyer confirms the payment, the acquirer sends a question through the card network to the issuer: may this card pay this amount?

text: The issuer checks the card and the money on the account.
prefix: The issuer checks the card and the money on the account.

text: Then it answers yes or no, in a few seconds.
prefix: Then it answers yes or no, in a few seconds.

text: That yes is a promise, written down.
prefix: That yes is a promise, written down.

text: It is a line in the tab book, not money.
prefix: It is a line in the tab book, not money.

text: The money moves later.
prefix: The money moves later.

text: Many payments travel together, in one batch, from the issuer through the card network to the acquirer.
prefix: Many payments travel together, in one batch, from the issuer through the card network to the acquirer.

text: That batch is called settlement.
prefix: That batch is called settlement.

text: Then the acquirer keeps its fee and pays the shop the rest.
prefix: Then the acquirer keeps its fee and pays the shop the rest.

text: So a payment has two moments: the yes, in seconds, and the money, later.
prefix: So a payment has two moments: the yes, in seconds, and the money, later.

text: Giving money back depends on which side of settlement you stand.
prefix: Giving money back depends on which side of settlement you stand.

text: Before settlement, no money has moved yet.
prefix: Before settlement, no money has moved yet.

text: So the line is simply crossed out, as if the payment never happened.
prefix: So the line is simply crossed out, as if the payment never happened.

text: That is a reversal.
prefix: That is a reversal.

text: After settlement, the money has already moved.
prefix: After settlement, the money has already moved.

text: Crossing out is too late, so the money must be sent back as a new movement.
prefix: Crossing out is too late, so the money must be sent back as a new movement.
